[b]March 5, 2028: New Decor[/b]

As the birthday of Polenne Strømm (which is on March 12) approaches, the city of Tharkønn and cities across Rosenmarkke have begun to decorate for the celebrations which are to take place. With the signing of D-37 the people finally feel they have direction and a future under the new regime, something which the past months hadnt granted them.

While overall support was still lower than optimal, analysts believed that a decrease in inflationary pressure over the month of February had spurred on the mood. 

In Tharkønn 30 foot tall banners of Strømm line the front of the former Grand Assembly building, now temporarily closed for renovations to ready the building for the SPC. Rosenmarkket flags hang over the avenues with the golden deer sigil appearing on whatever was legally permitted to carry the sigil. 

School children practiced patriotic songs in the streets after school, and the cafés buzzed wearily at the noise, wondering whether the revolution would ever end.

Rumors had filled the press networks that despite international pressures and a potential war on the horizon, the nations largest shipbuilders [i]Campaigne Generale-Mondiale[/i] were going to launch a 1,035 foot long 66,343 GRT ocean liner in her honour and under her name.

The vibes were immaculate, the scene was set, perhaps the glory of Rosenmarkke was truly at hand.
